In detail

The southern industrial belt, the Risiera di San Sabba memorial, and the post-war housing of Borgo San Sergio and Valmaura. Two specific findings: the derelict ex-Jutificio on via Svevo, reported as a site of squatting, dealing and an assault, with the Region stating it is ready to seal the building; and February 2026 anti-degrado operations at Borgo San Sergio and the ATER housing on via Valmaura, part of a sweep that identified 91 people and produced five charges. Residential and industrial, and not somewhere visitors stay.
